plugins.description: Local-first code intelligence for AI agents — BM25 + regex code search, symbol resolution, call-graph traversal, impact analysis, architecture detection, and token-efficient context packs from a local native binary. Index once, query locally. Supports Rust, TypeScript, Python, Go, Java, and JavaScript.
